overview: India's coral islands in the Arabian Sea: turquoise lagoons, shallow reefs and very few tourists. Agatti has the airport; Bangaram is a nearby island resort.
fit: Calm shallow lagoons are lovely for the 4-year-old; the 10-year-old can try snorkelling. Very limited facilities and medical care.
season: October–April is calm and sunny (25–32°C). Monsoon May–September has rough seas.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai–Kochi, then Alliance Air Kochi–Agatti (small ATR plane)
gettingThere.cost: ₹50,000–70,000 return for 4; sells out, book early

gettingThere.detail: Kochi to the islands on government ships

gettingAround: Boats between islands; walking on the island.

todo.title: Snorkelling
todo.why: Corals and turtles right off the beach

foodTips: Food is simple; carry snacks for the kids.
save: Book a package through SPORTS (Lakshadweep tourism) or a licensed operator, which includes the permit
Agatti stays are cheaper than Bangaram
safety: An entry permit is required for all visitors; arrange it through your operator
Life jackets in the water for the kids
Basic medical facilities: carry a full first-aid kit
health: Strong sun: rash guards, hats, reef-safe sunscreen
kids: Little to do at night; carry books and games

days.plan: Island hop to Bangaram or Thinnakara
